preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 0 <= n <= 1000 for n in test_case_counts)
preconditions.description: Each test case count n is an integer between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(package_name) <= 40 and all(c.isalnum() or c in '_-+.' for c in package_name) for package_name in package_names)
preconditions.description: Each package name is a string of up to 40 non-whitespace characters using the English alphabet, digits, underscore, minus, period, and plus.
Each package has at most 20 dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(dependency in package_names for dependencies in package_dependencies for dependency in dependencies)
preconditions.description: Each dependency is one of the other packages in the test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(order, list) and all(package in package_names for package in order) for order in orders)
postconditions.description: Each output order is a list of package names from the test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(package_names.index(order[i]) < package_names.index(order[j]) for j in range(i+1, len(order)) if order[j] in package_dependencies[package_names.index(order[i])]) for order in orders for i in range(len(order)))
postconditions.description: Each package in the output order is installed only after all its dependencies.

postconditions.expression: all(order == sorted(order) for order in orders)
postconditions.description: Each output order is lexicographically first among all valid orders.

postconditions.expression: all(order == 'cannot be ordered' or len(set(order)) == len(order) for order in orders)
postconditions.description: Each output order contains unique package names or is 'cannot be ordered'.
